name: writing-style
description: Hang Yu's writing style: 72 writing patterns with weighted evidence from instructions, hand edits, and 16 review records, entered through a short quick reference, and the committee writing style reference. polish-paper and review-paper use it for the wording of every proposal and review. It uses writing-vocabulary for technical terms when that plugin is installed, and works without it.
